name: Frying pan or skillet
definition: shallow, flat-bottomed pan with sloped sides and a long handle, for frying and searing; material is an attribute.

name: Wok
definition: deep, round-bottomed or flat-bottomed pan with high flaring sides, for stir-frying.

name: Grill pan or griddle
definition: pan with a ridged or flat cooking plate, for grilling or searing on a hob.

name: Saute pan
definition: a wide pan with straight or high sides and usually a lid, for frying, braising and reducing (section 14).

name: Saucepan
definition: deep round pot with one long handle, for boiling and making sauces.

name: Stockpot
definition: tall, large pot with two handles, for stock, soup and boiling in quantity.

name: Dutch oven or casserole
definition: heavy lidded pot, often cast iron, for braising and slow cooking on the hob or in the oven.

name: Pressure cooker
definition: sealed pot that cooks under steam pressure; stovetop or electric is a power-source tag.

name: Roasting pan
definition: deep, open oven pan for roasting meat and vegetables.

name: Baking tray
definition: flat oven sheet with low or no rim, for baking.

name: Gastronorm pan
definition: container made to the gastronorm size standard for commercial kitchens and serving counters (`market = commercial`, B-20).

name: Air fryer
definition: countertop appliance that cooks food in a basket by circulating hot air.

name: Toaster
definition: appliance that browns slices of bread with radiant elements.

name: Oven
definition: enclosed cooking appliance that bakes and roasts by heating the air in a chamber.

name: Hob or cooktop
definition: cooking surface of burners or heating zones on which pans are set.

name: Barbecue grill
definition: grill that cooks food over a fire, charcoal, gas or electric heat; fuel is a tag.

name: Rice cooker
definition: appliance that cooks rice in an inner pot under automatic control; `heating_technology` (conventional, micom, IH, pressure IH) is an attribute (section 14).

name: Bain-marie
definition: heated water bath that keeps food warm or cooks it gently (`market = commercial`, B-20).

name: Cookware set
definition: a set of pots and pans of one maker line, sold and rated as one object; the pieces are listed in `set_contents` (S3a, K-1, section 14).

name: Chef's knife
definition: general-purpose kitchen knife with a broad, curved blade for chopping, slicing and mincing.

name: Santoku
definition: Japanese general-purpose knife with a flat edge and a sheep's-foot tip.

name: Nakiri
definition: Japanese vegetable knife with a straight, rectangular blade.

name: Paring knife
definition: small knife with a short blade for peeling and fine work in the hand.

name: Kitchen utility knife [petty]
definition: mid-size kitchen knife between the paring and the chef's knife (not the trade utility knife of C1).

name: Bread knife
definition: long knife with a serrated edge for cutting bread.

name: Boning knife
definition: narrow, flexible or stiff knife for taking meat and fish off the bone.

name: Slicer [sujihiki]
definition: long, narrow knife for slicing cooked meat and raw fish.

name: Cleaver
definition: heavy, broad, rectangular blade for chopping through bone or, in the Chinese form, for all-purpose cutting.

name: Deba
definition: thick, single-bevel Japanese knife for butchering fish (rule R).

name: Yanagiba
definition: long, single-bevel Japanese knife for slicing raw fish (rule R).

name: Usuba
definition: thin, single-bevel Japanese vegetable knife with a straight edge (rule R).

name: Cutting board
definition: board of wood, plastic or composite to cut food on.

name: Knife sharpener
definition: stone, rod or device that sharpens or hones a kitchen knife's edge.

name: Grater
definition: hand tool with a surface of sharp-edged holes for shredding food.

name: Colander or strainer
definition: perforated or mesh bowl for draining or sieving food.

name: Spatula
definition: hand tool with a flat, broad blade for turning, lifting or scraping food.

name: Spice or pepper mill
definition: hand mill that grinds pepper or spices; a grinder made for coffee is B5.5.1.06.

name: Kitchen scale
definition: scale for weighing ingredients; app connection is an attribute.

name: Kitchen thermometer
definition: thermometer for the temperature of food, oil or an oven.

name: Kitchen timer
definition: timer that signals when a set cooking time has passed.

name: Pocket scale
definition: small portable scale for weighing small amounts (K-167).

name: Stand mixer
definition: countertop mixer with a bowl and a head that drives beaters, whisk or dough hook.

name: Food processor
definition: appliance with a bowl and interchangeable blades and discs for chopping, slicing and mixing.

name: Refrigerator
definition: insulated, powered cabinet that keeps food and drink cold; built-in or freestanding is an installation attribute.

name: Wine fridge
definition: refrigerated cabinet made to keep wine at storage or serving temperature.

name: Food storage container
definition: lidded container for keeping food.

name: Lunch bag
definition: insulated bag for carrying a meal and keeping it cool; "cool bag" is its synonym row (K-131).

name: Drink bottle
definition: reusable bottle for carrying a drink, whether or not made for a sport (K-161).

name: Hydration bladder
definition: flexible drink reservoir with a drinking tube, sold on its own (K-161).

name: Dinner plate
definition: large flat plate on which a main meal is served and eaten; a commemorative or display plate is this plate with a display tag (S5, K-182).

name: Table fork
definition: fork laid at the place setting for eating (replaces the memo placeholder "Table flatware").

name: Spoon
definition: spoon laid at the place setting for eating (replaces the memo placeholder "Table flatware").

name: Table knife
definition: knife laid at the place setting for eating (replaces the memo placeholder "Table flatware").

name: Steak knife
definition: sharp, often serrated table knife for cutting meat at the plate (B-20).

name: Butter knife
definition: blunt table knife for spreading butter (B-20).

name: Wine glass
definition: glass with a bowl shaped for drinking wine, stemmed or stemless.

name: Tumbler
definition: flat-bottomed glass without a stem.

name: Decanter
definition: glass vessel into which wine or spirits are poured to serve.

name: Mug
definition: large cup with a handle, used without a saucer.

name: Cup [tea or coffee cup]
definition: handled cup for tea or coffee, usually used with a saucer; a cup and saucer sold together is filed here (S3a).

name: Saucer
definition: small shallow dish on which a cup stands.

name: Serving tray
definition: tray made to carry and serve food and drink (K-182, K-191).

name: Hard placemat
definition: rigid mat set under a place setting; a textile placemat is B2 (B5-O1).

name: Coaster
definition: small hard mat set under a glass or cup (B5-O1).

name: Semi-automatic espresso machine
definition: espresso machine with a pump in which the user grinds, doses, tamps and starts and stops the shot.

name: Super-automatic espresso machine
definition: espresso machine with a built-in grinder that grinds, doses, tamps and brews at one touch.

name: Manual lever espresso machine
definition: espresso machine in which a hand lever drives the water through the coffee.

name: Drip coffee maker
definition: machine that drips hot water over ground coffee in a filter into a carafe.

name: Moka pot
definition: stovetop pot that pushes boiling water by steam pressure up through ground coffee.

name: Coffee grinder
definition: burr or blade grinder made for coffee beans; hand or electric is a tag, burr size an attribute.

name: Teapot
definition: lidded vessel with a spout and handle for brewing and pouring tea; Yixing is a non-maker named form.

name: Kyusu
definition: Japanese teapot with a side handle (rule R).

name: Gaiwan
definition: lidded bowl on a saucer for brewing tea (rule R).

name: Kettle
definition: vessel that boils water; stovetop or electric is a tag; tetsubin is a provisional non-maker named form.

name: Water filter jug
definition: jug with a filter cartridge that treats water for drinking (B-33; the cartridge is B7, K-11).

name: Cocktail shaker
definition: closed vessel in which a cocktail is shaken with ice.

name: Jigger
definition: double-ended measure for spirits.

name: Dishwasher
definition: appliance that washes and dries dishes, cookware and cutlery.

name: Dish rack
definition: rack on which washed dishes stand to drain and dry (B-33).

name: Oven glove
definition: insulated glove or mitt for handling hot cookware.

name: Apron
definition: garment worn over clothes to protect them while cooking.

name: Vending machine for food and drink
definition: machine that dispenses food or drink on payment.
